message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | # | Rule | Explanation | |---|------|-------------| | 1 | **Objective** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned when you finish a round by playing all your cards and the other players’ remaining cards are scored. | | 2 | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | 3 | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). On a turn you may either:
• Play one card from your hand that matches the discard pile’s color, number, or symbol.
• Or draw one card from the draw pile. If the drawn card can be played immediately, you may do so on the same turn. | | 4 | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Changes play direction (useful in 2‑player games to skip the opponent).
• **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and misses a turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the new active color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – Same as Wild, but next player also draws four cards. It can only be played if the player has no matching color cards; otherwise they risk being challenged. | | 5 | **Playing a Card** | You may only play one card per turn unless you have a special “+4” or “+2” rule that allows you to stack them (see optional rules). | | 6 | **Calling “UNO!”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to call UNO when required results in a penalty: the player who missed it must draw two cards. | | 7 | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Reverse/Skip = 20 points each, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | 8 | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. The first player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | | 9 | **Optional Rules** | • **Stacking** – Players may stack +2 or +4 cards on top of each other, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative amount unless they can counter with another +2/+4.
• **No “+4” Challenge** – Some groups allow Wild Draw Four to be played at any time, ignoring the “no matching color” restriction.
• **Custom Decks** – Uno can be played with themed decks (e.g., Uno Attack, Uno Spin) that add extra mechanics. | **Quick Tips** * Keep track of the current color and number to anticipate opponents’ moves. * Use Wild cards strategically to change the color when you’re stuck. * Remember to shout “UNO!”—it’s a simple but crucial part of the game!
